requirement.description: Missing import for 'ecdsa' package causing multiple signature-related tests to fail. Tests like test_private_key_to_public_key, test_private_key_to_address, test_sign_message_hash, and test_recover_address are failing due to ImportError.
requirement.contract: Ensure the ecdsa package is properly imported and available when cryptographic functions are called. The functions private_key_to_public_key, private_key_to_address, sign_message_hash, and get_signer_public_key should be able to import and use the ecdsa library without errors.

requirement.description: Missing import for 'hashlib' package causing signature-related tests to fail. Tests like test_private_key_to_address are failing due to ImportError.
requirement.contract: Ensure the hashlib package is properly imported and available when cryptographic functions requiring keccak hashing are called. The function private_key_to_address should be able to import and use hashlib without errors.

requirement.description: RLP encoding implementation has incorrect handling of integer encoding for edge cases. Tests like test_rlp_encode_integer are failing due to incorrect encoding.
requirement.contract: Fix the rlp_encode_int function to correctly encode integers according to RLP specification. The function should properly handle all integer values including edge cases like 0, 127, and large integers.

requirement.description: RLP decoding has issues with handling hex strings and raw hex data. Tests like test_rlp_decoding_prefix_hex are failing due to ValueError from fromhex() when processing invalid hex data.
requirement.contract: Fix the rlp_decode function to properly handle hex string validation and conversion. The function should gracefully handle malformed hex data and raise appropriate errors instead of crashing with ValueError.

requirement.description: CREATE2 address computation is failing due to missing hashlib import and incorrect data handling. Tests like test_get_reated_address are failing with ValueError.
requirement.contract: Ensure the hashlib package is properly imported and used in the get_created_address function for CREATE2 address computation. Fix the handling of hex data for salt and init_code parameters.
